REPORT · MAR 2024
Holding the line on the Bárðardalur peat block.

Water table within 6 cm of surface for 142 of 168 monitored days, with a single deviation in early April. A short photo essay.

REPORT · APR 2024
Six fortnums estuary returns 1,072 ha to tidal exchange.

The Marghera N. sluice was opened in April, ending a thirty-year embankment regime. Salinity has returned, and the gulls.

12 MIN · 8 PHOTOGRAPHS
REPORT · MAY 2024
Peat hydrology restored across the Lisbean headwaters.

All 88 tile drains lifted, surface micro-topography re-graded by hand against the watershed envelope. The Tarn now meanders.

METHODOLOGY
EU-RES.04
Field measured

Hectares restored are counted only after a second-quarter monitoring window with documented vegetative return, not at the moment of planting or rewetting.

UNIT · HECTARE · CONSERVATIVE
EU-FIN.02
Conservative accounting

Euro amounts are counted at the moment of disbursement, not at the moment of pledge. The Foundry does not capitalise pledged future giving.
